id.description: The unique ID for the banner, used for aria-controls and element targeting.

ariaLabel.description: The custom aria label users can override.

flagSrc.description: URL for the decorative banner flag image. Defaults to img/us_flag_small.png under the configured asset base.

tld.description: The top level domain for the site. Defaults to `.gov`

bannerText.description: The text for official government website text.

bannerActionText.description: Action text label "Here's how you know."

domainHeading.description: Heading text for the domain section.

domainText.description: Body text for the domain section.

httpsText.description: Body text for the HTTPS section.

className.description: Additional classes to add to the banner
